invariants.rationale: The method constructs an executor using 'context', so it must be non-null.
The 'compactionInstantTime' is passed directly into the executor, so it cannot be null.
The method always returns the result of 'convertMetadata', which should be non-null if executed as expected.
HoodieWriteMetadata implementations are typically expected to have non-null partition write stats.
'result' is parameterized with List<WriteStatus> and is created by a conversion method; its write statuses list should be non-null.
